name: The Power to Destroy...
summary: In the Undercity, Varimathras sends Horde adventurers into Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner wants two dark tomes held by the Searing Blade cult, hoping their power will aid her war against the Scourge and the Lich King.

sections.title: A Borrowed Arsenal
sections.body: Thrall's orcs are hunting the Searing Blade cult beneath their capital, while the Forsaken covet the cult's occult stores. On Sylvanas Windrunner's orders, Varimathras sends operatives into Ragefire Chasm to seize two demonic grimoires: Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether. The Dark Lady believes disciplined Forsaken will can put these demonic gifts to better use than the lesser cultists.

sections.title: The War for Liberation
sections.body: Varimathras explains the tomes' purpose once they are secured. Their dark magic is meant to strengthen Sylvanas's campaign against the Scourge. By claiming every scrap of forbidden power, the Forsaken hope to break the Lich King's hold across Lordaeron and free the remaining undead from his mental enslavement.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras want books from underneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm hold powerful demonic tomes. Lady Sylvanas believes their knowledge is wasted on cultists and wants to turn it against the Lich King.

faq.q: What books are you sent to collect?
faq.answer: You are sent to collect two spellbooks from Searing Blade cultists and warlocks: Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether.

faq.q: Where does Varimathras reside in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Varimathras resides beside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity.

faq.q: How does this relate to the Forsaken's overall goals?
faq.answer: Sylvanas gathers every tool she can to wage war against the Scourge. Forbidden demonic arcana could help the Forsaken break the Lich King's dominion over the undead.

faq.q: Does Thrall know the Forsaken are taking these books?
faq.answer: Orgrimmar's leaders are focused on purging the traitors and demons beneath their streets. Varimathras's order to retrieve the books is presented as quiet business for the Dark Lady, rather than an official joint Horde decree.
The Searing Blade is a secretive sect of the Shadow Council in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. Its members practice dark demonic magic beneath the Warchief's nose.

angles.text: As Forsaken, your journey across the Great Sea to plunder Orgrimmar's underbelly serves your alliance with the Horde and the Dark Lady's ambition to destroy the Scourge.
As a warlock, retrieving Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether means wresting dangerous Legion arcana from reckless cultists.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Orgrimmar's foundations by clearing the Searing Blade, while the magical spoils go to the Undercity's vaults.
